summary: SparkyFitness is a self-hosted alternative to commercial applications like MyFitnessPal. It records nutrition, physical exercise, body measurements, and general health metrics in a centralised database.
goodFor: It is suitable if you want to track your personal health and dietary data locally rather than relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: The software is distributed under a proprietary licence rather than an open-source one, which may restrict how you audit, modify, or redistribute the code.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volume mounts for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
